title: Equilibrium Points and Stability for a Cubic Autonomous ODE
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the equilibrium points and classify their stability for dy/dt = y(y - 2)(y - 4).

steps.title: Test Signs of f(y) in Each Interval
steps.mathExpression: y < 0: f < 0 (\downarrow); \quad 0 < y < 2: f > 0 (\uparrow); \quad 2 < y < 4: f < 0 (\downarrow); \quad y > 4: f > 0 (\uparrow)
steps.explanation: Determine whether y increases or decreases.

steps.title: Classify Stability
steps.mathExpression: y = 0: \text{arrows point away (unstable)}; \quad y = 2: \text{arrows point toward (stable)}; \quad y = 4: \text{arrows point away (unstable)}
